articles.title: ACCIDENT: Out-of-Control Car Puts Pedestrians at Risk, Rickshaw Driver Has Narrow Escape
articles.description: A frightening road accident took place in Delhi’s Shakti Nagar after a car reportedly lost control while travelling at high speed. The vehicle began swerving dangerously from one side of the road to the other, putting pedestrians and other road users at risk. It eventually overturned on the road with a loud impact, shattering its windows. A rickshaw driver narrowly escaped being hit by the out-of-control car. One of the occupants was seen being dragged along the ground, and people inside the car suffered injuries. As soon as the accident occurred, people present at the spot rushed to help and pulled the occupants out of the damaged vehicle. Two people managed to escape from the car with the assistance of bystanders. After rescuing them, locals also helped turn the overturned car back onto its wheels. Despite the severity of the crash and the danger posed to people nearby, no fatalities were reported. The incident highlights the risks associated with speeding and careless driving on busy city roads.
